model_cache.embedding: embedding.py107-133 caches only model instances, max2; ordinary encode recomputes query vectors unless query_cache separately supplies one.
model_cache.reranker: chat.py76-87 caches fixed model/revision/device/cache_folder instances, max2. rerank is executed for each candidate call.

conditional_normal_retrieval_caches.enablement: answering/service.py1524-1527: frozen command retrieval_optimization==validated_release_cache_v1. knowledge/service.py1339 requires owner cache_scope, PostgreSQL, no allowed_chunk_ids. Other branches retain reference validation.
conditional_normal_retrieval_caches.release_snapshot: knowledge/cache.py65-111: key=(database bind, release id, current transactional invalidation epoch, digest configuration/manifest), LRU2. Cache hit still obtains invalidation epoch; returned hits undergo current persisted source and vector validation plus final epoch check. No source gate bypass.
conditional_normal_retrieval_caches.query_vector: query_cache.py16-41: requires E5/enabled/scope. Hashed key includes VERSION+owner scope+complete frozen configuration+runtime_device+query; TTL300s, max256. Reuses only vector, no answer or retrieved text. Cross-session repeat of same effective query for same owner/config/device can hit.

trace_fields.retrieval_execution.retrieval_stages.rel: Actual validated-release snapshot cache hit, not model/query cache hit.
Time for cache.load including epoch checks and cache lookup or full snapshot validation/construction.
trace_fields.retrieval_execution.retrieval_stages.que: Actual boolean returned by encode_query; false also applies when caching not applicable.
encode_query duration, including lookup or actual query encoding.
trace_fields.retrieval_execution.retrieval_stages.den: Database cosine query + current retrieved-hit validation + result construction.
trace_fields.retrieval_execution.retrieval_stages.lex: Lexical index search only; subsequent source-hit validation is outside this sub-timer.
trace_fields.retrieval_execution.retrieval_stages.ret: knowledge.service.retrieve1356-1444, through final source epoch validation; excludes later interactive rerank.
trace_fields.retrieval_execution.rerank_ms: ranking.py92-107: normal predict timing includes waiting for per-model prediction lock. chat trace copies from ranked result.
trace_fields.retrieval_ms: answering.service1480-1786 outer elapsed; includes normal retrieve, frozen rerank and subsequent retrieval processing.
trace_fields.retrieval_execution.execution_device: Resolved runtime override or frozen policy device.

interpretation_limits: Loading model objects before timer does not precompute questions, release snapshot, query vectors or first GPU inference.
Warm model instances do not remove first-query inference/setup, release validation or database/cache differences.
Different order/questions/arms and repeated same-owner queries may mix cold and warm paths.
Exact four persisted traces are needed to attribute actual cache hits or substage times. Source alone does not establish these actual runtime values.
Four genuine case timings establish observed functional latency only, not a controlled hybrid-versus-dense speed improvement.
